claim_scope: 28 nm SRAM-class measured proxy radiation arrivals plus a joint write-state-read model for architecture scenarios

let.interpretation: 5-year mission-average spacecraft-shielded silicon LET spectrum, 1.0 g/cm2 Al equivalent

proton.interpretation: proton-energy block from the same 5-year, 1.0 g/cm2 Al-equivalent SPENVIS run

heavy_ion_proxy_table.ensemble_policy: pointwise minimum, median and maximum of three measured 28 nm bulk memory proxies

scenario_policy.measured_bands_partial: use measured ST28 FDSOI points only from 2-8 MeV and Kintex-7 points from 80 MeV upward; set the unsupported 8-80 MeV gap to zero
scenario_policy.cross_technology_log_bridge: log-log interpolate across the unsupported 8-80 MeV gap between two different measured proxy technologies
scenario_policy.gap_plateau_ceiling: use the Kintex-7 80 MeV cross section throughout the unsupported 8-80 MeV gap

paired_radiation_scenarios.interpretation: measured-band partial contribution; not a mathematical lower bound for the target SRAM
cross-device engineering proxy, not a fitted target response
deliberately conservative unsupported-gap scenario, not a confidence bound

electrical_condition_table.status: ngspice PTM32 engineering Monte Carlo; not foundry PDK or target PEX

system_scenarios.required_for_total_ber: replace PTM32 engineering priors and pre-layout parasitics with target foundry statistical models/PEX, then use validated rare-event statistics and temporal-noise inputs

output_policy.joint_model: radiation toggles the stored state after a possibly non-ideal write; the read decision is conditioned on that state
